Relieve the jammed core by deleting overloaded hubs into refined deep holes and hole-filling rattlers, then two-phase exponential tangential annealing with sharp convergence while deferring LP to a final polish.

Rattler/hub-targeted basin-hopping with deep-hole re-insertion plus cheap annealed soft-max tangential repulsion and capped trust-region LP only on promising basins.

Escape the jammed 1100-contact optimum by repeatedly deleting overloaded hubs into refined deep holes and shaking caps, smoothing only with fast exponential tangential repulsion to allow hundreds of basin hops, saving trust-region LP for one final squeeze.
Population basin-hopping with diverse archive, cluster rotations and Jacobian null moves, SA acceptance and capped LP polishing.
direction: Run non-greedy population basin-hopping with diversity preservation and strict time control: maintain an archive of up to six polished local optima that are mutually distinct, measured by a contact-adjacency fingerprint at tolerance $10^{-6}$ and a Procrustes-aligned RMS distance above 0.03, and generate offspring by rotating a whole connected contact cluster of 5–15 points through a random 2-plane by 0.05–0.2 radians or by displacing points along the smallest singular vectors of the active-contact Jacobian, then smooth and briefly LP-polish each offspring. Accept worse offspring with simulated-annealing probability $\exp(-(v-v_{\text{best}})/T)$ with $T$ decaying from $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-6}$ so the search can cross barriers instead of always restarting from the incumbent, check the clock every iteration, cap every LP call at 2 seconds, stop all exploration at 140 seconds, and spend the remaining time polishing the archive's best member.
